note: Deterministic concept-distribution markers for the superconducting quantum-error-correction held-out fixture, frozen before the first LIVE request of M13.7.9. A section 'carries' a concept when every pattern group in `all` matches somewhere in that section's stripped text (LaTeX \% is already turned into % by the stripper). Owner = the section designated by argumentUnitsV2 to explain it fully. Markers locate candidates; harmfulness is decided by the classification layer and by reading. Markers are NOT widened after outputs are seen; misses are reported alongside manual counts.

concepts.label: 表面码扩展前提（更多比特 → 更强保护但更多错误源；错误密度须足够低）
all: (物理|物理量子)?比特.{0,14}(数量|数目|越多|增加|增多|更多|规模)
